bootstrap.interval: Percentile 2.5% and97.5%; conditional on this one trained pair, not training-replica uncertainty.
bootstrap.primary_success: Observed marginal Q1 difference >0 AND bootstrap95% lower bound >0. Secondary contrasts descriptive; no multiplicity adjustment or automatic promotion.
bootstrap.statistic: Recompute each model marginal Q1 separately within each resampled set; subtract repeat4_final from repeat1_final.
bootstrap.unit: Shared D9 game-seed cluster; one common resampled seed-index vector across all models and inference controls.

evaluation.cohort: D9 proposed0xD9000000..0xD90003FF; must reserve before use
evaluation.primary: Difference of marginal worst-quarter means: Q1(repeat1_final at repeat1 sampled inference) minus Q1(repeat4_final at repeat1 sampled inference). Sort each model survival distribution separately; never take Q1 of the within-seed differences.
evaluation.secondary: Each final model versus starting420 at repeat1; all repeat4 outcomes secondary. Fixed final-frame checkpoints, no best-of-time selection.

frame_accounting: Sum actual returned gameplay elapsed_raw_frames; retain the complete final vector step, stop before another; optimize all collected rows. Exclude and separately report all startup frames. Each arm may overshoot by less than64*its action_repeat; arm budgets differ by at most256frames.
frame_target_reason: 180 four-frame update-equivalents beyond chosen420, comparable exposure to the remaining horizon toward prior600; not600 additional updates.
optimizer_contract: One Adam step per effective minibatch after weighted microbatch accumulation. Normalize advantages over the entire macro-batch; clip gradients once. Nominal128steps/full rollout per arm. Record actual KL early-stop, partial-rollout epochs and optimizer steps.

qualification.scope: Registered resource qualification only; disposable model/Adam changes never reused for finaltraining. Restore420 for formalarms.

shared.ent_coef_scope: Unchanged per-decision coefficient in averaged PPO loss; no claim of matched trajectory entropy or a fourfold entropy-force equivalence.
shared.pool: Same accepted uniform512 pool; paired deterministic per-slot episode streams; exclude all reserved evaluation ranges including D7/D8/D9.
shared.restore: Same420 model and Adam; paired reset of all supported training RNG state using registered pairseed before each arm.

work_cap_scope: Training plus fixed evaluation; accept only after measured qualification and independent resource review. No reuse of the old4h cap.
